# k-gov-skills

> Korean public-sector AI skills for official reports, source-grounded research, HWP/HWPX documents, meeting minutes, public APIs, legislation tracking, and travel-expense evidence.

Repository: https://github.com/mouseco/k-gov-skills
Homepage: https://mouseco.kr/treasure/k-gov-skills-public-sector-ai-skills
Install guide: docs/install.md
Security policy: docs/security-and-secrets.md
Attribution: docs/attribution.md

## Install

List all available skills:

    npx skills add mouseco/k-gov-skills --list

Install one skill globally:

    npx skills add mouseco/k-gov-skills --skill official-report-skillset -g

Install all skills globally:

    npx skills add mouseco/k-gov-skills --all -g

## Skills

- alio: inspect institution-level ALIO public disclosures
- deep-research-pro: build source-grounded policy and institutional research briefs
- g2b-bid-search: search Korean public procurement notices
- gov-meeting-minutes: turn transcripts into official-style meeting minutes and detailed records
- hwpx-mouseco: create and validate Korean public-report HWPX documents
- korean-law-search: search Korean laws and legal sources
- kosis-stats: query official Korean statistics from KOSIS
- national-assembly-tracker: track National Assembly bills and official follow-up sources
- official-report-skillset: structure decision-ready Korean public-sector reports
- public-data-finder: find datasets and APIs on data.go.kr
- read-hwp: read and convert HWP/HWPX documents
- transport-receipt-collector: collect authorized transport receipts for expense evidence
- trip-expense-hwp: package travel-expense HWP forms and receipt evidence

## Operating boundaries

- Prefer official sources and record source URLs and reference dates.
- Never invent laws, numbers, decisions, speakers, approvals, or expenses.
- Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, internal documents, personal data, seals, or signatures in the repository.
- Stop at CAPTCHA, OTP, identity verification, payment, cancellation, submission, or account changes.
- Open generated HWPX, HWP, PDF, and receipt files and verify the actual artifact before declaring completion.
